variants.R4: hidden component 'Rivets R4 F1-F4 (hidden)' + hidden body 'Oven sheet R4 (rivet holes)'

g2_glass_edge_to_lip.note: ray from the nominal glass edge (rounded rectangle glass_*, R_glass) outward to the first frame material, at the side midpoints and the 45 deg corner points; Z = flush plane, the two arris ends, mid, glass back (the recess narrows 1 deg to the back)

g1_cutout_to_lip.note: ray from the nominal sheet cut-out edge (glass + s_cut, R_cut) inward to the lip outer face, at the flush plane, mid sheet and 0.25 above the sheet back (above the R0.2 lip-root fillet)

3_flush_and_gaps.pip_note: to_glass_back_mm = pip top Z_PIP_TOP -> glass back Z_GLASS_BACK (0.50); to_glass_mm is to the glass body, which sits 0.02 behind the print layer there
